_note: Rotation rules live in data, not code. Sources are TODO(source) (docs/SOURCES.md). Rules only raise a visible flag; no yield number is changed by an unsourced rule.

sameFamilyFlag.reason: Same botanical family two seasons in a row can build up pests and diseases.

legumeCredit.note: A legume can leave nitrogen for the next crop. This changes fertiliser need, not water need, so SAMA does not change water or yield for it.
